# vendor/gridstack

Pinned copy of `gridstack@11.3.0` dist files (`gridstack-all.js`,
`gridstack.min.css`, `gridstack-all.js.LICENSE.txt`) — previously loaded from
`cdn.jsdelivr.net`, vendored so preview/CI runs stay hermetic.

Do not edit by hand — bump the pin by replacing the files and updating this
README + the `index.html` comment.
